title: ﻿∫−11∣x+1∣dx\int_{-1}^{1} |x+1|dx∫−11​∣x+1∣dx﻿ এর মান কোনটি হবে?

mcq_questions.description: ﻿∫−11∣x+1∣dx=∫−10∣x+1∣dx+∫01∣x+1∣dx=∫−10(x+1)dx+∫01(x+1)dx=[−(x22+x)]−10+[x22+x]01=0+(12−1)+(12+1)−0=−12+32=1\int_{-1}^{1}|x+1|dx\\ =\int_{-1}^{0}|x+1|dx+\int_{0}^{1}|x+1|dx =\int_{-1}^{0}(x+1)dx+\int_{0}^{1}(x+1)dx\\ =[-(\frac{x^{2}}{2}+x)]_{-1}^{0}+[\frac{x^{2}}{2}+x]_{0}^{1} \\ =0+(\frac{1}{2}-1)+(\frac{1}{2}+1)-0\\ =-\frac{1}{2}+\frac{3}{2}=1∫−11​∣x+1∣dx=∫−10​∣x+1∣dx+∫01​∣x+1∣dx=∫−10​(x+1)dx+∫01​(x+1)dx=[−(2x2​+x)]−10​+[2x2​+x]01​=0+(21​−1)+(21​+1)−0=−21​+23​=1﻿
